reviews.shade: COSRX Advanced Snail Peptide Eye Cream
reviews.text: The product is relatively good. If your skin only needs moisture under the eyes, this cream will suit you as it did for me. My skin got very elastic and full of moisture. Those who have dark circles under the eyes or fine lines are better off using an eye cream that contains retinol or caffeine.
reviews.zh: 產品相對嚟講係好嘅。如果你眼底下只係需要保濕，呢枝霜就啱你用，我用完都係咁覺得。我塊皮膚變得好有彈性又水潤。有黑眼圈或者細紋嘅人就比較適合用含有retinol或者咖啡因成分嘅眼霜。

reviews.shade: COSRX Advanced Snail Peptide Eye Cream
reviews.text:
I love this cream, very light and hydrating, feats purfectlly my oily skin at the heat of summer.
I use it on all of my face and neck skin and its amazing for oily skin as a full face cream, I dont feel oilly
reviews.zh:
我好鍾意呢枝霜，好輕又保濕，完美啱我夏天熱辣辣嘅油性肌。
我搽成塊面同頸，對油性肌嚟講做全臉面霜真係好正，完全唔覺油笠。

reviews.shade: COSRX Advanced Snail Peptide Eye Cream
reviews.text: Lightweight eye cream from a pump. Absorbs oay, Takes a good 2.5 minutes before I can layer on anything else. Pretty much unscented. Good for sensitive skin. Only started using a week, eill re-review if I buy this product again. Not sure it its going to be on my must have hit list yet. So far so good.
reviews.zh: 泵裝嘅輕身眼霜。吸收得幾好，要等大概2.5分鐘先至可以再疊其他嘢上去。基本上冇味。啱敏感肌。只係用咗一個星期，如果再買嘅話會再評。暫時未肯定會唔會加入回購list。暫時睇落OK。

reviews.shade: COSRX Advanced Snail Peptide Eye Cream
reviews.text:
まだ効果を感じていません。目元の乾燥じわ用に書いましたが、塗った後もすぐにちりめん皺になってしまいます。私の目元に合っていないのか？効果が出るのに時間がかかるのか？取り敢えず1本使い切ってからリピートするか考えます。
発送は日本まですぐに届いたし初回購入でとてもお安かったので満足しています。
reviews.zh:
暫時仲未感受到效果。本來係買嚟對付眼底嘅乾燥細紋用，但搽完之後好快就變返皺紋紙咁。係唔係唔啱我眼底用？定係要時間先去見效？總之等我用晒成枝先再諗要唔要回購。
寄貨方面，日本直送好快到，而且首次買有優惠價，好滿意。

reviews.shade: COSRX Advanced Snail Peptide Eye Cream
reviews.text: Yo uso una sola plump para los dos ojos ya que no se necesitan mucho, he notado que las arrugas y mis ojeras han disminuido bastante, la textura es lo que esperaba, parecida a la de la escencia, se siente fresco, lo recomiendo ya que los efectos se notan en aproximadamente 2 semanas.
reviews.zh: 我兩隻眼共用一pump就夠，因為唔需要好多。用咗之後發覺皺紋同黑眼圈都減淡咗唔少，質地都係我預期嗰種，似爽膚水嘅質感，搽上面好清爽，推薦畀大家，大概2個星期左右就見到效果。

reviews.shade: COSRX Advanced Snail Peptide Eye Cream
reviews.text: Siempre tengo problemas con la crema para el contorno de los ojos, me causan irritación y a la final tengo que dejar de utilizarlas… pero esta es la primera que tolero, además de tener una consistencia muy agradable y que se absorbe súper rápido. Realmente ha mejorado la textura de la piel de mis ojos, la ha aclarado y ha disminuido la líneas de expresión. Soy muy feliz de haberla probado y estoy muy conforme con el resultado!
reviews.zh: 我一直用眼霜都出事，會刺激到我，搞到最後要停用……但呢支係我第一支用到冇事嘅，而且質感好舒服，吸收得超快。真心改善咗眼周皮膚嘅質感，膚色有提亮，皺紋都減淡咗。好開心試到呢枝，對效果好滿意！

reviews.shade: COSRX Advanced Snail Peptide Eye Cream
reviews.text: I had a lot of dryness around my eyes and have sensitive skin. This provided a lot of moisture and the dry patches around my eyes have gone away. Very light and did not irritate my skin or eyes.
reviews.zh: 我眼周好乾，而且係敏感肌。呢枝提供到好多保濕，眼周嘅乾燥甩皮都已經冇咗。好輕身，冇刺激到我塊面或者眼。

reviews.shade: COSRX Advanced Snail Peptide Eye Cream
reviews.text:
I'll confess that its my first time using an eye cream,and I absolutely happy for starting with this one^^ the application is nice and smooth,not sticky or runny. Makes me wake up and feel refreshed especially if you are like me and have dark eye bags from lack of sleep xd
Also with this one,it has alot of product in one pump so I recommend not using alot or use one pump on both under eyes^^
But yeah after few days of using it I do feel a slight change^^
reviews.zh:
要坦白講，呢個係我第一次用眼霜，好慶幸第一支就揀到呢枝^^ 搽起上嚟又滑又順，唔會黐住亦唔會太水。瞓醒之後塊面感覺refresh咗，尤其係好似我咁因為捱夜而有大眼袋嘅人xd
另外，呢枝一pump嘅份量已經好多，所以建議唔好用太多，或者兩邊眼共用一pump就得^^
不過用咗幾日之後的確感覺到有少少變化^^

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
